versions.changelog:
Initial release — introduces VPC border firewall management for Alibaba Cloud CEN Basic Edition.

- List and inspect VPC firewall slots and diversion switch status.
- Onboard (attach) or offboard (remove) business VPCs from firewall.
- Open or close traffic diversion per VPC.
- Diagnose and troubleshoot common VPC firewall issues and permission problems.
- Clear parameter confirmation and environment/CLI readiness checks.
- Read-only and write actions require explicit permissions, with structured failure handling guidance.
